description: Defines retention behaviour for dataset versions. Specifies how many versions to keep, archiving strategy, and cleanup rules. Configuration only — no cleanup jobs or archiving logic is implemented.

station_codes.notes: Moderate-change dataset. Retain recent versions for comparison.

notes: Retention policy registry. Defines how dataset versions are retained, archived, and cleaned up. No cleanup jobs, archiving logic, or file management is implemented. These policies will be consumed by future retention phases.
